question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (2)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**with**" denotes the inclusion or presence of something. (साथ में)
 
• In the context of the passage, whole grains are "loaded with" minerals, indicating they contain a lot of minerals.
 
• The other options: "**over**," "**of**," and "**from**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Plus, they're loaded with__ minerals like calcium, potassium, magnesium, zinc and iron - important building blocks for a strong immune system and healthy heart.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Over (से ऊपर)**: means extending directly upward from.
 
• **Of (का)**: indicates relationship or connection.
 
• **From (से)**: indicates the point in space at which a journey, motion, or action starts.
